blocks.html: Robinsons Galleria recently celebrated a milestone event with the The Voice Philippines Season 2 Grand Winner Jason Dy as he received his Gold Record award for his self-titled album under MCA Music Philippines at Robinsons Galleria Activity Area. Unaware of the surprise awarding, The Voice of RNB Jason Dy thought of the event as a thanksgiving mall show for his fans. He started the event with a beautiful rendition of Can’t Stop the Feeling and got his biggest surprise when his co-artists Edray Teodoro, formerly part of The Voice’s Team Bamboo and Fil-Am teen and Bay Area Sweetheart Micka Gorospe went up the stage and sang his hit songs- Caught in that Feeling and Break my Heart. The big reveal happened when the host called out MCA representatives Mark Bonifacio and Neil Gregorio to come up the stage and present Jason Dy’s Gold Record Award.
